title: Deception Probe Robustness to Prompt-Format Shift

original_idea.body: # Deception Probe Robustness to Prompt-Format Shift. Train an Apollo-style deception probe, then measure how its false-positive rate on benign chat rises under surface-format shifts (JSON, code-comment, roleplay).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Monitor reliability under format shift maps directly to whether deception monitoring is deployable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Replicate linear probe + reformat benign chat; guided, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped FPR-vs-format-shift experiment with clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reliability audit of a leading monitor with open models; labs underweight.

low_compute.reasoning: Linear probe on one open model + reformatted benign chat, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Apollo probes recent; format-shift robustness angle plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Probe robustness to surface-format shift plausibly under-studied.
